main_text.l: existimant, tanquam ædificationi aduersa. Proderit autem horum omnium consideratio, tùm ad alios vsus suo loco dicendos, tùm ad maiorem eorum quæ de gratiæ & redemtionis vniuersalitate hactenus exposuimus, certitudinem. Etenim Pelagianorum olim reliquiæ, vt & hodie, neminem prorsus à redemtione sanguinis Christi exceptum perhibentes, & quantũ ad Deum attinet, paratam omnibus vitam æternam contendentes, ad talis gratiæ prædicationẽ idcirco delapsæ sunt, quòd refugerent confiteri, Deum secundum propositũ & cõsilium voluntatis suæ, iudicio qui-dem occulto, sed opere manifesto, aliud vas condere in honorem, aliud in contumeliam, nec acquiescerent prædestinatorum numerũ nec augeri nec minui posse.

page.notes: Marginal quotation marks ("„") at line ends are printed punctuation of the text, not notes. The word "Cap." at the lower right is a catchword-like mark, transcribed as a foot line. Some lines are faint; "quidem" and "vas" readings are slightly uncertain.
